evidence: Modifies src/private_broadcast.cpp, src/private_broadcast.h, and src/net_processing.cpp to hold transactions and initiate outbound private connections at target block heights.
rationale: Extends the private broadcast subsystem to queue transactions until a scheduled block height to conceal creation time and handle future locktimes without external schedulers. Author cites addressing open feature request #34118 ('[feature] Scheduled Transaction Broadcast') for user convenience and timing privacy.
